text:
maya: Uploaded a microcard prototype for first-run: tiny card in the top-right that surfaces 'Create API key' + one sample. Goal: less real-estate, faster path. Quick UX/a11y pass please. :sparkles:

leo: Quick look  I like the minimalism. Two nitpicks: 1) the microcard's shadow is very faint on light themes. Add a 1px separator. 2) the sample CTA looks like a link, not a button. Make it a clear button with an icon.

jin: A11y: ensure the microcard is reachable via skip link or tab order. The close button needs aria-label 'Dismiss onboarding microcard'. When the sample is focused announce: 'Sample: Q&A demo. Press Enter to run.' Use role=button on the card if the whole card is clickable.

nora: Copy: headline 'Try a sample' is bland. Suggest 'Run a sample in seconds' and tiny subcopy 'Includes prompts + runtime settings'. Also add telemetry hint in footer: 'We send anonymized events to improve onboarding  Manage in Settings.'

leo: Small behavior: when user is already authed, hide the 'create key' CTA and show 'Run sample' primary. For non-authed, disable Run with tooltip 'Create a key to run hosted samples'.

jin: Mobile: microcard should collapse to an icon in the bottom-right on small screens to avoid covering content. Also respect prefers-reduced-motion for entrance animation.

maya: Good. Let's A/B test microcard vs inline banner. Ryan (not here) will wire experiment flags. Deploy preview: https://preview.redwood-inference/internal/microcard/1987654321 (build 2026-03-24-05) -> deploy-bot: preview up.

maya: Action items: jin -> aria labels + focus order; leo -> visual anchor + disabled tooltip; nora -> final copy + tiny telemetry link. Quick AXE pass after changes. :thumbsup:
